Name: MPlayer Lite M3U Buffer Overflow
Description: This module exploits a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in MPlayer Lite r33064, caused by improper bounds checking of an URL entry. By persuading the victim to open a specially-crafted .M3U file, specifically by drag-and-dropping it to the player, a remote attacker can execute arbitrary code on the system.
Targets: Windows XP SP3 (DEP Bypass) / MPlayer Lite r33064
